annotations.title: Search guides for foreigners in Spain

description: Searches Guía Extranjeros, a free trilingual navigator of procedures for foreigners in Spain (residence and immigration, NIE/TIE, arraigo, EX forms, temporary protection, health card, work, benefits, housing, taxes, grants). Returns matching guides with a one-sentence summary, status, the date each was last checked against the official source, and a link.

lang.description: Language of the guides: "es" Spanish, "en" English, "uk" Ukrainian. Default: Ukrainian for Cyrillic queries, otherwise English.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "TIE first time", "arraigo sociolaboral", "empadronamiento", "digital nomad visa".
